note: Publisher RSS feeds for the /headlines/ aggregator. These are chosen to work from CI runners (Google News RSS 503s from datacentre IPs, so it's avoided). 'soapSpecific: true' feeds are entirely about soaps (all items kept); on general feeds only items mentioning a soap are kept. The aggregator stores only a headline, publisher and link — never article bodies. Add or swap feeds freely; any that fail are skipped.
